fonts.usage: Brand name 'Jeana Marie's', signatures, playful accents
Main headings 'Kitchen Club', editorial cookbook feel
Supporting copy, UI text, kids profiles (friendly rounded sans)

rules: Use Cream/Ivory for backgrounds (never pure white unless for specific card contrast).
Deep Espresso for all primary text for high contrast readability.
Terracotta for primary CTAs and active states.
Honey Mustard for playful accents and kids' profile highlights.
Soft Sage for success states and natural, earthy touches.

surfaces: Adult UI: Organic & Earthy archetype. Flat backgrounds, subtle borders, soft diffuse shadows. Use 'Clay & Crisp' neomorphism for interactive elements.
Kids UI: Playful bright theme. High contrast, rounded elements, 'Pastel & Soft' archetype with neo-brutalist contrast (soft colors + solid borders).
Journal Editor: Styled like a real notebook with lined backgrounds, handwritten script accents, and paper textures.
borders_and_radius: Adult: Subtly rounded corners (md to lg).
Kids: Fully rounded, pill shapes, playful thick borders (2px to 4px).
textures: Use subtle paper/grain texture for adult cookbook pages.
Use lined notebook patterns for the journal sections.

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12 for sections. Mobile-first constraints.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: Use Mode A (Tetris) for the landing page storytelling, Mode B for the admin dashboard.
layouts_and_grids.kitchen_mode: Dedicated layout for kitchen mode: Large touch targets, simplified navigation, text-2xl/3xl for recipe steps, high contrast, sticky controls to prevent dirty screen touches.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped for kids, slightly rounded rectangular for adults. Distinct hover states.
components.cards: Cardless or subtle borders for adult recipes. Playful, elevated cards for kid content.
components.forms: Use Shadcn customized. No native inputs.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header for adult UI. Simplified icon-heavy bottom nav for kids.

rules: Playful bounce for kid UI interactions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Espresso text on Cream meets WCAG AA.
accessibility.kitchen_mode: Ensure massive touch targets (min 60x60px) and voice/audio cues if possible for hands-free or messy hands.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.

image_urls.description: Kids cooking together, great for landing page family connection section.
Mother and child baking, ideal for 'Mom & Dad Quick & Easy' or community section.
Open blank notebook, use as background or reference for the Journal Editor.

icons.usage: lucide-react (default) for adult UI, iconoir-react for kid-friendly playful icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind for custom layouts on the landing page, and heavily customized Shadcn for the dashboard/app.
Implement the 'Kitchen Mode' toggle which increases all text sizes, simplifies UI, and removes distractions.
The kids profiles must use the 'Pastel & Soft' archetype with heavy borders and Honey Mustard accents.
Do not use generic font Inter. Use Dancing Script, Merriweather, and Nunito.
Use JS files instead of TSX for this project since we are using regular JS.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
Do not center align the app container. Text should flow naturally left-to-right.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
